description: The donut chart, titled “Task Type,” visually represents the distribution of two distinct journalistic tasks involving generative AI: “Article generation” and “Headline generation.” The larger segment, colored in a muted red, accounts for 83.2% of the total and is labeled “Article generation,” indicating it is the dominant task. The smaller segment, colored in yellow, represents 16.8% and is labeled “Headline generation.” The chart uses a clean, minimalist design with percentage values displayed next to each label, and the central white space contains the title “Task Type” in bold black text. No legend is present, as the labels are directly associated with their respective segments. The visual emphasizes the significant disparity between the two task types, with article generation overwhelmingly more prevalent than headline generation in the context of the study.
